Kennedy Airport by Gholamhossein Darzi, Iran's permanent representative and chargé d'affaires to the United Nations. ​ En route to New York, Araghchi made a brief stop in Doha, where he held consultations with Qatari officials regarding the latest regional developments. ​ President Masoud Pezeshkian will also depart for New York on Tuesday to attend and address the 81st UN General Assembly; he is scheduled to meet and hold consultations with a number of world leaders and officials on the sidelines of the summit. 📲 @Irna_en​

current.content: 📡 Interior Minister: Iran-Pakistan borders to operate around clock 📌 Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing that relations between Iran and Pakistan are strategic and deep, Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni said that following bilateral agreements, the two countries' existing border crossings will operate around the clock, and a new crossing will be opened at Kuhak. Momeni, has met with Pakistan’s Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi in Tehran. ​ During Monday’s meeting, Momeni and Naqvi emphasized finalizing agreements to expand bilateral relations. ​ Naqvi invited Momeni to visit Pakistan. ​ Pakistan’s interior minister has made several trips to Tehran since Pakistan began its mediation efforts between Iran and the United States. ​ During his latest visit on August 10, he met President Masoud Pezeshkian, security chief Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, and Momeni. 📲 @Irna_en​

current.content: 🎙 Pezeshkian to travel to New York for UN General Assembly 📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian will travel to New York on Tuesday to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, the director-general of the Presidential Office’s Public Relations Department says. Habibollah Abbasi told IRNA on Monday that Pezeshkian will address the UN General Assembly and hold meetings with a number of heads of state and senior officials attending the gathering. ​ The president is also scheduled to meet Iranian expatriates, as well as US intellectuals and representatives of American think tanks, Abbasi said. ​ The 81st session of the UN General Assembly opened on September 8 under the theme “Restoring Trust, Managing Transformation: A United Nations That Delivers for All.” ​ The high-level general debate is scheduled to begin on September 22, with Pezeshkian expected to deliver his address on Wednesday, September 23. ​ The United States has approved visas for Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to attend the gathering. 📲 @Irna_en​

current.content: 💬 Iran calls for immediate action to halt Israeli genocide of Palestinians 📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran has called on the international community to take serious and decisive action to put an end to the Israeli genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity against Palestinians in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank. In a statement issued ahead of the annual session of the United Nations General Assembly on Monday, the Foreign Ministry expressed deep concern and revulsion over the continuation of Israeli crimes against the Palestinian people, highlighting the international community’s responsibility to act to stop the genocide. ​ The ministry also strongly condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s “shameless desecration” of Al-Aqsa Mosque and the violation of the sanctity of al-Buraq. ​ It said Israel, which has been committing one of the largest genocides in modern history in Gaza over the past three years with comprehensive military, financial and political-media support from the United States and certain countries claiming to defend human rights, has simultaneously resorted to systematic and widespread assassination and torture of Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank. ​ The ministry further said that an average of at least three Palestinian prisoners are killed under torture every month, describing this as evidence of the “apartheid and colonial nature” of Israel and criticizing its supporters for remaining indifferent to serious violations of human rights and international humanitarian law. ​ “Immunity granted to this regime by the United States, including through intimidation and sanctions against international court judges and human rights activists and rapporteurs of Palestinian people, must not disrupt the ideal of pursuing justice and freedom for Palestine or demanding the prosecution and punishment of Israeli criminals,” it added. ​ The ministry also argued that Israel’s occupation, terrorism, lawlessness, and crimes in the occupied Palestinian territories, as well as its actions against regional countries over the past eight decades, have seriously undermined the credibility of the United Nations and international law. ​ It called for immediate steps to halt the genocide, prevent further occupation and seizure of Palestinian land, deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza and hold those responsible for crimes accountable. 📲 @Irna_en​

current.content: 🎙 Baqaei: Attending UNGA not a privilege, a legal right 📌 Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says that Iran will not abondon its right to be present in the UN General Assembly, stressing that attending the UN meeting is not a prividlege given by Washington. Baqaei stressed that being in New York held absolutely no charm for Iranian representatives, but it was a trench that must not be abandoned. ​ Speaking in a televised program, the Foreign Ministry spokesperson emphasized that participating in the UN General Assembly was a legal right rather than a favor from others, as Iran was one of the 50 founding member states of the UN. ​ Recalling that seven months had passed since recent conflicts and crimes against Iran, Baqaei stated that the country had a duty to attend the most important international event to make the justice and rights of the Iranian people heard by the world. ​ He pointed out that the opposing side used every tool to prevent the Iranian delegation’s participation, ranging from derogatory remarks and media propaganda to abusing its commitments as the host government by creating delays or refusing to issue visas for several delegation members. ​ Baqaei affirmed that such sabotage and negative propaganda would never cause Iran to back down from its legitimate right to attend the summit and explicitly explain the principled positions of the Islamic Republic and the great Iranian nation. 📲 @Irna_en​
